text:
joel: Quick field report from the cross-family GPTQ run I finished this morning. ran Llama-2-70b, Mistral-7b-v0, Qwen-14b through the same GPTQ-4 pipeline + our AWQ fallback passes. TL;DR: Llama and Mistral look safe for 4-bit GPTQ with small accuracy hits; Qwen shows larger deltas and some long-context KV issues so treat as opt-in until we fix the runtime mapping.

maria: nice — can you paste the top-line numbers?

joel: sure — copy/paste from eval-run log:

```
Bench / Model         FP16 baseline   GPTQ-4   delta
MMLU                 Llama-2-70b     71.4      70.5     -0.9
                     Mistral-7b      62.0      61.4     -0.6
                     Qwen-14b        68.1      65.6     -2.5
HellaSwag            Llama-2-70b     91.2      90.8     -0.4
                     Mistral-7b      84.0      83.8     -0.2
                     Qwen-14b        88.0      87.0     -1.0
GSM8K (pass@1)       Llama-2-70b     58.0      55.5     -2.5
                     Mistral-7b      43.2      41.4     -1.8
                     Qwen-14b        62.5      58.5     -4.0
Instruction QA (LLM-eval) Llama-2-70b  86.0      85.2     -0.8
                            Mistral-7b  78.5      78.0     -0.5
                            Qwen-14b    81.0      78.5     -2.5
```

joel: Notes on perf and memory: GPTQ-4 runtimes measured on H100-80GB. Llama-70b (gptq-4 + fp16-KV) reduced peak GPU memory by ~42% and latency was ~1.6x compared to FP16 (better batching helps). Mistral-7b had the best latency/throughput uplift (small model, high token throughput). Qwen-14b had the worst quality delta and we observed KV cache mismatch on >1024 token sequences leading to subtle corruption for some conversational traces.

deepa: can you explain the KV mismatch? is it runtime or quantization?

joel: early signal points at a layer-weight packing order mismatch between our GPTQ exporter and the runtime remap for Qwen's grouped attention layout. basically some per-layer reshapes were applied in a different order which doesn't matter for FP16 but breaks the index mapping for 4-bit packed keys. temporary mitigation: run with `--kv-keep-fp16` flag (keeps KV cache in fp16) or use AWQ-4 fallback which reconstructs keys in fp32. both increase memory but avoid corruption.

sam: so what's the recommended deploy profile per family?

joel: recommended short list: 
- Llama-2-70b: gptq-4 + fp16-KV, enable prefix caching, canary on dedicated-8xA100 pool. good for read-heavy Q&A where small MMLU deltas are ok.
- Mistral-7b: gptq-4 aggressive batching profile (low memory), production ready for most inference types.
- Qwen-14b: DO NOT auto-rollout to gptq-4. use gptq-4 behind a canary with `kv-keep-fp16=true` OR prefer AWQ-4 for generation workloads. schedule further per-layer quant tuning before wider rollout.

maria: any concrete config snippet I can add to rollout policy?

joel: yep, example canary route config we used: 
```
route: /models/qwen-14b/gptq-4-canary
resources:
  gpu_type: a100-40gb
  replicas: 2
quant:
  method: gptq
  bits: 4
  kv_mode: keep_fp16
  fallback: awq-4
rollout:
  traffic: 1% -> 5% -> 25% (monitor: mmlu_delta, latency_p99, kv_error_rate)
```

ci-bot: CI: gptq-4 export tests passed for Llama-70b and Mistral-7b, Qwen exporter had 1 failing reshape test.

eval-bot: Eval summary uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-evals/2146051123/gptq-crossfamily-summary.html

maria: what about retraining or fine-tuning to recover GSM8K loss for Qwen?

joel: short answer: per-layer rescale + outlier folding helped a bit in dev tests. plan: run targeted PTQ calibration on attention-out and ff layers 10..20; if that still misses target, we try a light 1-epoch LoRA on math prompts. schedule: start per-layer PTQ sweep tomorrow, 24h run.

sam: risk calc? if we roll Qwen gptq to prod and it underperforms on GSM8K/instruction, customer impact?

joel: high for any product relying on few-shot math or multi-step reasoning. recommended: gate Qwen gptq by eval checks and keep fallback to fp16 in the routing policy.

deepa: for infra, if we enable kv-keep-fp16, what's the memory delta?

joel: ~+8-12GB on H100 for Qwen-14b vs pure gptq-4. acceptable for dedicated pools but not for smallest shared pods.

maria: thanks — can you drop the raw CSV outputs in the ticket? i'll add to the onboarding doc.

joel: done: attached csvs to ticket #ML-4321 and pushed the export artifact. next actions: (1) PTQ per-layer sweep for Qwen, (2) AWQ fallback stress tests on long-context, (3) canary configs + SLO checks in console.

sam: :thumbsup: schedule a quick sync after the PTQ sweep results.

joel: ack. ping me if you want the run commands — here is the eval command used: 
```
python scripts/run_eval.py --models llama-2-70b,mistral-7b,qwen-14b --quant gptq-4 --bench mmlu,hellaswag,gsm8k,instr_eval --out-dir /tmp/gptq-crossfam-214605 --kv-keep-fp16
```

maria: :eyes: good work, thanks joel.
